messages.subject: ability estimation for the mixed format test
parts:
Dear Chalmers, 
I have a question about ability estimation of mixed-format tests. It is possible to obtain ability estimate from the mixed-format tests (multidimensional or unidimensional)  via the mirt package?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Re: ability estimation for the mixed format test
parts:
Yes, just specify the item type using c() on 'itemtype' argument per item.
